_description: Hand-labelled answer-quality eval corpus for a HANDWRITTEN note (cs-notes-1: a single handwritten C++ introduction/history page). New category for the P0 multi-category extension: HANDWRITTEN CONTENT — the first corpus exercising the scan→VLM parse route (parse/pipeline.py::_parse_scan_with_vlm, spec docs/specs/scan-vlm-parse.md). The note is image-only (no text layer): Docling's printed-text OCR can't read cursive and crashed on it, so the doc reaches the index ONLY via the whole-doc Qwen3-VL-8B transcription. This corpus proves the full handwritten path end-to-end: handwriting → faithful VLM transcription → retrieval → grounded answer / counterfactual refusal.
_labelling_rule: ANS queries: `_anchor_phrase` is a distinctive verbatim substring from the transcribed chunk holding the answer; resolve via FTS. REF: should_refuse=true, relevant_chunk_ids=[]. All 4 REFs are IN-CORPUS-UNANSWERABLE C++ counterfactuals — facts a reader of THIS note might ask but the note does NOT state (++ etymology, the latest C++ standard, recommended IDE/compiler software, memory-management model). Each is a training-known C++ fact, so they specifically test that the agent suppresses model knowledge and refuses when the SOURCE is silent (the same discipline as the BGP-timers counterfactual). They are C++-topic so retrieval surfaces the note's chunks — the gate is 'the fact isn't here', not 'nothing retrieved'.
_purpose: Validate the scan→VLM handwritten path under the answer-quality HARD GATES: refusal_rate_on_counterfactuals == 1.0, zero hallucinations. First handwritten-content corpus; closes the long-standing P2.3 scan-corpus gap.
_source_note: A CC-BY handwritten C++ note (HumynLabs CS-Notes set; the source PDF stays LOCAL at ~/memex_eval_logs/handwritten/cs-notes-1.pdf - only this query set ships). Image-only PDF (image_area_fraction 0.85, chars_per_page_avg 0) -> ingested with MEMEX_PARSE__DISABLE_VLM=false -> the scan route fired (parse.scan.start/done) -> Qwen3-VL-8B transcribed the page. The scan route strips the whole-page ```markdown fence the VLM wraps its full-page output in (_strip_markdown_fence_wrapper), so the note indexes as real markdown, not a code block (3 chunks; pre-strip it was 4, incl. a junk ```markdown fence chunk that degraded grounding). The transcription preserved 'Bjorne' (the note's handwritten spelling of Bjarne Stroustrup) - answers cite it verbatim.

_baseline_2026_05_27.stack: Qwen3-8B-AWQ orchestrator + EmbeddingGemma-300M (native prompts) + bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cross_encoder, bf16; reranker on CPU for 12 GB co-residence), top_k=5
_baseline_2026_05_27.index: 3 chunks via the scan->VLM route (Qwen3-VL-8B whole-page transcription; Docling-OCR crashed on this image-only PDF, worker exit 5). The ```markdown fence wrapper is stripped at parse.
_baseline_2026_05_27.run: 2026-05-27, full vault (cs-notes-1 alongside CCNA/CR350/CUDA/10-K/etc.), reranker on CPU (MEMEX_MODELS__RERANKER_DEVICE=cpu)
_baseline_2026_05_27.notes: HARD GATES hold: refusal_cf=1.0 (all 4 in-corpus-unanswerable C++ counterfactuals refused without fabricating training-known facts - ++ etymology, latest standard, IDE, memory model), 0 hallucinations, citation precision 1.0. ANS 4/6 - the headline facts answer FROM the transcribed handwriting: developer/year/org (Stroustrup/1979/Bell Labs), original name 'C with Classes', 'middle-level' + the reasoning, and the supported paradigms. The 2 false-refusals are NON-fabrication misses, not quality failures: (05 'compiled or interpreted?') verify returned no grounded claims - the note says 'It is an imperative and a compiled language' and the grounder won't bridge the pronoun 'It'->C++ (the same conservatism that prevents hallucination); (06 'compilation stages?') retrieval dilution - the tiny note's compilation chunk lost the rerank competition to the large mixed vault's CUDA/networking chunks. Both are small-doc-in-large-vault / pronoun-grounding limits orthogonal to the handwritten path; scoping to the doc (the doc-picker) recovers 04 and the path itself is proven. The fence-strip recovered +1 (handwritten-04 paradigms: 3/6 -> 4/6). FIRST corpus to exercise the scan->VLM parse route end-to-end (handwriting -> faithful transcription -> retrieval -> grounded answer / counterfactual refusal).
